## Tainted Explorer (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 Male assimilated human expert 2/ranger 2  
 NE Medium humanoid (human)  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** Perception +5  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+1 dodge, +4 armor, +1 Dex)  
 **hp** 30 (4 HD; 2d8+2d10+10)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +4, **Will** +3  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** battleaxe +8 (1d8+6/x3 plus disease) or handaxe +7 (1d6+4/x3 plus disease) or dagger +7 (1d4+4/19–20 plus disease)  
 **Ranged** rifle +4 (1d10/x4)  
 **Special Attacks** combat style (two-handed weapon), favored enemy (humans +2)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 13, **Con** 14, **Int** 8, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +7 (+9 sunder); **CMD** 19 (21 vs. sunder)  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Sunder, Pushing Assault, Weapon Focus (battleaxe), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +5, Climb +8, Craft (drawing) +4, Intimidate +5, Knowledge (geography) +3, Knowledge (local) +3, Knowledge (nature) +5, Perception +5, Profession (woodcutter) +5, Stealth +6, Survival +7, Swim +7  
 **Languages** Common  
 **SQ** assimilated, track +1, wild empathy +3  
 **Gear** rifle with 5 metal cartridges; **Other Gear** masterwork chain shirt, dagger, battleaxe, handaxe, mindslave harness  

**Special Abilities**

 **Assimilated (Su)** This explorer was once neutral good, but his alignment shifted to neutral evil due to the perfected version of the assimilation strain.  

 **Contagious (Su)** As an infectious carrier of the assimilation strain, the explorer continues to expose those he touches or wounds in combat.
